input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
input.rationale: The grant in paragraph 2 runs to "Customer" only, with no coverage for AP affiliates or contractors acting on AP's behalf and no path to add them, and it is expressly "non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense" and "revocable". As drafted the licence is revocable at Kubient's discretion at any time during the Term, which sits at the playbook walk-away line; the separate revocation on termination in paragraph 4(c)(ii) is acceptable but the unqualified "revocable" is not. The non-transferability also conflicts with paragraph 8(h), which permits assignment to an affiliate, asset purchaser or successor by merger. Redline extends the grant to affiliates and contractors, makes it sublicensable and transferable to permitted successors, and limits revocation to expiration or termination under paragraph 4.

proposal.summary: Extend platform licence to AP affiliates and contractors, permit successor transfer, and remove revocability at will.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Auction Platform licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, made it transferable to a successor consistent with the assignment provision in paragraph 8(h), and removed the at-will "revocable" language so the licence ends only on expiration or termination under paragraph 4. As a fallback we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to Kubient.

ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license, sublicensable to such affiliates and contractors and transferable to any successor or assignee permitted under paragraph 8(h), which license shall not be revocable except upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with paragraph 4, to access, participate in and use
